title: Tier frontier: supplied bandwidth per GB stored
conventions: Peak per-direction vendor specs unless basis says otherwise; 1 TB = 1000 GB, 1 PB = 1000 TB. Every plotted value is derived (D) as bandwidth / capacity; not read from charts. $/GB shown as relative strings only.

extraction.method: Read deck text lines and rendered slide text for each spec; recomputed all ratios; fetched Vistara camera-ready PDF to fulltext/vistara-isca26.pdf and read Table V and Table VI; read Xeon Max arXiv text.

caveats: B200 8 TB/s / 192 GB is NVIDIA spec not in our files (FLAG G7).
A64FX 1 TB/s / 32 GB is from secondary sources (Wikipedia/MEMSYS'24 via r3 D7); 1000/32 = 31.25, brief says 32.
MRDIMM capacities 1/2/4 TB assume 1DPC with 64/128/256 GB DIMMs; not printed on slides.
Vistara 57.6 GB/s is Table V spec, not described as a measurement; the point label 'Vistara, measured' follows the brief but the 0.225 is derived from a table value.
RDMA GB/s per GB range has no source derivation; assumed configs reproduce it. 3.5 us latency end not located; Fastswap prints 3.9 us.
Energy fields are for report only and carry scope strings; never compare across scopes.
$/GB values copied from SYNTHESIS v1.3 section 2 and notes r2a; not independently verified; no HBM4 $/GB.
